html:
G'oya

Guruh kalit ustun emas, sanadan olingan ifoda: yil va oy. Sanani matnga aylantirib, birinchi 7 belgisini olsak, aynan 'YYYY-MM' chiqadi. Har bir guruhda ikki narsa hisoblanadi: miqdorlar yig'indisi va turli kunlar soni.

Yechim

SELECT SUBSTR(CAST(measured_on AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month,
       SUM(mm) AS mm,
       COUNT(DISTINCT measured_on) AS rainy_days
FROM rainfall
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(measured_on AS TEXT), 1, 7)

COUNT(DISTINCT measured_on) bir kunda nechta o'lchov bo'lishidan qat'i nazar kunni bir marta sanaydi. Namunada mart oyida 4 ta o'lchov bor, lekin ular 3 xil kunda: 2-, 15- va 31-mart.

Tuzoqlar

COUNT(*) o'lchovlarni sanaydi. Namunada mart 4, aprel 3 yomg'irli kun bo'lib chiqadi, aslida 3 va 2:

Noto'g'riSELECT SUBSTR(CAST(measured_on AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month,
       SUM(mm) AS mm,
       COUNT(*) AS rainy_days
FROM rainfall
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(measured_on AS TEXT), 1, 7)

Faqat oy raqami bo'yicha guruhlash (EXTRACT(MONTH ...) yoki strftime('%m', ...)) 2023 va 2024-yilning noyabrini bitta qatorga qo'shadi.

Dialektlar farqi

Har bir dialektning o'z funksiyasi ham bor. PostgreSQL'da:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT TO_CHAR(measured_on, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(mm) AS mm, COUNT(DISTINCT measured_on) AS rainy_days
FROM rainfall
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(measured_on, 'YYYY-MM')

SQLite'da:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT strftime('%Y-%m', measured_on) AS month, SUM(mm) AS mm, COUNT(DISTINCT measured_on) AS rainy_days
FROM rainfall
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', measured_on)
